newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures erode more late, end near lows.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures erode more late, end near lows.

text.p: U.S. debt futures eroded further near the close and finished moderately lower and hugging pit-session troughs.
March Treasury bond futures fell again on closing bank sales, some of which traders said hit sell stops, as longs leery of the contract's further upside potential bailed out.
"A lot of it was long liquidation," said one floor broker after the close. "The weakness of the session carried through."
Brokers also said firms may have been bracing for the expiration at midday Friday of March T-bond futures-options.
The broker said the final drop in nearby T-bonds, which tugged the contract to a daily low at 113-00, filled in a tiny gap on the daily chart.

The listing managed to hold above key Gann support at the 112-28/32 after spending a good portion of the day struggling with a 113-08/32 support level. It finally retreated and stayed below that point in the last hour.

Losses in the U.S. dollar as well as steepening declines in U.S. stocks added weight. "Anything with a 'U.S.' on it has been sold, and the description I would put on it is liquidation...profit-taking," said another floor broker.
Brokers said market tone seemed weak, with futures unable to rise much even on normally supportive economic news.
"The market doesn't take good news as well," said the second broker. "The tone has been very negative the last two days."

Futures showed muted response in light morning trading to mixed U.S. economic data. January U.S. housing starts rose less than expected to a 1.350 million unit annual rate. But that was offset by signs of economic firmness when weekly jobless claims rose 1,000 to 309,000 from a revised 308,000 in the prior week.

Futures firmed to the day's peak but stalled below resistance near 113-18/32 after showing limited downside response when the February Philadelphia Federal Reserve index rose to 17.4 instead of falling to 10.0 as traders had expected.

March T-bonds ended down 19/32 at 113-01, T-notes fell 11/32 to 109.23/32, muni-bonds lost 17/32 to 117-07/32, June T-bills ended flat at 94.95, and Eurodollars lost one bp to 94.40. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
